_meta.note: JSON has no comments; rubric lives in _rubric below. Do NOT edit cases or the rubric during Phase 3 tuning (3C). Freeze at the end of 3A after Grayson's review by setting frozen=true. Adding cases later is a NEW scorecard, not an edit to this set.

_rubric.scoring: any-variant: a case is a HIT if AT LEAST ONE of its 2-3 rendered variants is usable.
_rubric.usable_definition: The rendered PBR maps read as the prompted material without manual graph repair. Opening the .ptex in Material Maker to tweak to taste is fine; opening it to fix breakage is a MISS.
usable_requires_all: every must_have criterion is visibly present in the rendered maps
no render errors (RenderResult.ok is true, all four maps produced)
no obviously broken map: albedo not flat-black or flat-white, normal not flat (uniform blue), heightmap/orm not uniform
_rubric.gate: >= 70% hit-rate (>= 11 of 15 cases) with any-variant scoring, Grayson-audited, recorded in STATUS.md.
_rubric.judging: Claude vision scores each case against must_have/must_not; Grayson audits every miss + a sample of hits. Disputed case = Grayson rules.

must_have: copper/orange-brown metallic base tone
green-to-teal verdigris patina in recessed or aged areas
metallic albedo with non-uniform roughness (patina duller than bare metal)
must_not: clean uniform polished copper with no patina

must_have: neutral light-gray metallic tone
fine directional brush streaks visible in normal or roughness
anisotropic-looking directional variation, not isotropic noise
orange-brown rust patches over a darker metal base
rough, pitted surface where rust has formed
roughness higher on rusted areas than on remaining bare metal
must_not: green patina (that is copper, not iron)

must_have: regular running-bond brick coursing (offset rows)
recessed mortar lines visible in the heightmap/normal
red-to-brown brick color with lighter mortar
must_not: random noise with no brick pattern

must_have: speckled gray base with fine mineral grain variation
low roughness consistent with a polished stone surface
subtle multi-tone speckle (light and dark flecks), not a single gray
light-gray rough concrete base
network of dark cracks recessed in the heightmap
surface roughness variation and subtle staining
must_not: clean smooth concrete with no cracks

must_have: parallel plank divisions with gaps/grooves between boards
directional wood grain running along the plank length
warm brown wood tone with grain-driven color variation
faded gray-brown weathered wood tone
pronounced rough grain and splitting along the grain
higher roughness than fresh finished wood
twill/woven diagonal thread pattern in the normal
indigo-blue base with subtle thread-level color variation
matte, high-roughness cloth surface
organic cellular/wrinkle grain typical of leather
warm brown tone with subtle highlight/lowlight in the grain
medium roughness, soft non-metallic surface
green moss patches over a darker soil/earth base
irregular organic clumping, not a regular grid
bumpy relief from moss and debris in the heightmap
polygonal cracked plates (dried-mud cell pattern)
deep recessed cracks between plates in the heightmap
tan/brown earth tone, matte high roughness
regular hexagonal cell pattern
metallic tone with cell edges raised or holes recessed in the heightmap
consistent manufactured regularity across the tile
regular hexagon tile layout with recessed grout lines
white/off-white tile faces with a low-roughness glazed look
grout lines darker and rougher than the tile faces

cases.prompt: rusted painted steel, paint peeling to bare metal
must_have: a painted top layer (flat colored coat) partially removed
rust and/or bare metal exposed where paint has peeled
roughness contrast between smooth paint and rough rust
irregular peel edges, not a clean geometric mask
must_not: fully clean paint with no wear
fully rust with no paint remaining
